about: Every published SDK release that evaluates flags locally, pinned by URL and digest (#1497). tests/sdk-contract/test_published_ruleset.py downloads each one, checks the digest before unpacking it, and feeds it the ruleset the server sends (ruleset-vectors.json); the integration test test_ruleset_published_sdk_compat.py feeds the Python ones the route's own bytes. expectation is what the release must do with that ruleset: accepted (it loads it, answers like the server and a later kill switch reaches it) or format-refused (it hands every flag back to the server). Changing it to format-refused is a decision, not a fix. published_versions_check.py fails when a registry holds a release with a local evaluator that is not listed here.
